head_commit.message:
Add opt-in output token replay for OpenAI requests (#52742)

## What changed

- Add the disabled-by-default `output_token_replay` feature to request `output.encrypted_content` from OpenAI providers.
- Preserve encrypted message and tool-call output, message and function-call status, and output-text `annotations` and `logprobs` through history and replay. Update the generated protocol schemas and SDK types.
- Strip output ciphertext from requests to other providers while retaining it in stored history, including after replay is disabled. Remove encrypted content from memory extraction inputs.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for the feature/provider combinations, metadata replay across follow-up requests, and history preservation when resuming with replay disabled.

head_commit.message:
Allow model catalogs to override incremental tool notices (#52736)

## What changed

Add `model_messages.tools.incremental_tools` overrides for the update hint, tool and namespace removal headers, and namespace instruction update and clearing messages. Missing, null, or over-512-byte values fall back to bundled wording; empty strings omit static text while retaining runtime names and instructions.

Substitute `{name}` in namespace message templates and append runtime instructions verbatim. Wording changes alone do not trigger tool catalog updates.

## Testing

Extend unit tests and MCP request-history snapshots to cover custom wording, empty notices, tool removal and restoration, and namespace instruction changes and clearing without repeating unchanged tools or notices.

Allow model catalogs to override incremental tool notices (#52736)

## What changed

Add `model_messages.tools.incremental_tools` overrides for the update hint, tool and namespace removal headers, and namespace instruction update and clearing messages. Missing, null, or over-512-byte values fall back to bundled wording; empty strings omit static text while retaining runtime names and instructions.

Substitute `{name}` in namespace message templates and append runtime instructions verbatim. Wording changes alone do not trigger tool catalog updates.

## Testing

Extend unit tests and MCP request-history snapshots to cover custom wording, empty notices, tool removal and restoration, and namespace instruction changes and clearing without repeating unchanged tools or notices.

head_commit.message:
Report terminal program status with OSC 7501 (#52725)

## Why

Lifecycle status reporting was limited to direct iTerm2 sessions. OSC 7501 lets other terminals receive Codex's program state.

## What changed

- Emit OSC 7501 with `app=codex` and states `idle`, `working`, or `blocked` whenever stdout is a terminal, including multiplexed sessions. Report `blocked` when user action is required.
- Continue emitting iTerm2's OSC 21337 status and bounded activity details in direct iTerm2 sessions.
- Clear status before handing the terminal to an external program, as well as on suspension and exit, and re-emit the current state after returning.

## Testing

Add coverage for OSC 7501 encoding, combined iTerm2 output, clearing both protocols, and protocol selection across terminal and multiplexer environments. Update lifecycle tests and status snapshots for the new protocol.
